paper.title_en: Apparent horizon mergers in analytic intial data
paper.abstract_en: Five years ago Pook-Kolb, Hennigar and Booth published a series of three papers exploring the evolution of apparent horizons and other marginally outer trapped surfaces during a black hole merger. This was seen to be much more intricate than the well-known "pair-of-pants" merger associated with event horizons. In this paper we show that parameter evolutions of Brill-Lindquist-deSitter initial data mimic many of the features of that evolution. Hence, this analytic intial data is a useful testing ground for ideas about marginally outer trapped surface evolution and spacetime geometry during mergers.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文以解析初始数据（Brill-Lindquist-deSitter）模拟黑洞并合过程中表观视界及边际外陷获面的复杂演化，为研究并合期时空几何提供了解析检验场，与广义相对论基础（陷获面、视界概念）直接相关；理论深度适中，方法基于解析数据参数演化，新论文零引用属中性。
decision.title_zh: 解析初始数据中的表观视界并合
decision.abstract_zh: 五年前，Pook-Kolb、Hennigar 和 Booth 发表了三篇系列论文，探讨黑洞并合过程中表观视界及其他边际外陷获面（marginally outer trapped surfaces）的演化。人们发现，这一过程比与事件视界相关的著名“裤子对”（pair-of-pants）并合要复杂得多。本文表明，Brill-Lindquist-deSitter 初始数据的参数演化再现了该演化过程的许多特征。因此，这一解析初始数据是检验关于并合过程中边际外陷获面演化及时空几何之想法的有用试验场。
